newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China's Liaoning Electrical signs US$6.9 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: China's Liaoning Electrical signs US$6.9 mln loan.

text.p: Liaoning EFACEC Electrical Equipment Co Ltd's US$6.9 million term loan facility has been signed, arranger Sumitomo Bank said on Monday.
The deal is guaranteed by the Bank of China, Liaoning Branch.
The facility has a final maturity of five years. It pays an interest margin of 80 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate.
The participation fee is 50 basis points.
Repayment is seven approximately equal semi-annual instalments with two years grace.
Lenders are Sumitomo Bank and Yamaguchi Bank, Dalian branch.
